newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Avesta Sheffield sets up Russian sales co.
newsitem.headline: Avesta Sheffield sets up Russian sales co.

text.p: Swedish-British steel group Avesta Sheffield AB said on Friday it established a sales company for stainless steel in St Petersburg, Russia.
In the initial phase the new company will focus on wholesalers and manufacturing companies.

"Avesta Sheffield is expanding its sales organisation as political and economic developments open new business possibilities in eastern Europe," said company spokesman Lennart Hallergard in a statement.
In line with company strategy, the expansion is well-balanced, Avesta Sheffield said.
"We expect the development possibilities to be very favourable in the CIS countries," the company said.
The next step could be to set up a company in the Urals area, the company said.
